newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Beneficial Corp raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Beneficial Corp raised.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Friday it raised Beneficial Corp to aggressive buy from buy. It was at 58-1/8, up 1.
- "Shares of Beneficial haven't nearly performed as well as the company's underlying fundamentals would suggest," analyst Michael Durante said in a report.

- The company's private label "retail" cards for retailers such as Kmart Corp and other credit card programs could provide "tremendous future earnings momentum," he said, adding that Beneficial may also be an attractive acquisition target.
- He kept earnings estimates at $5.50 a share for 1996 and $6.30 a share for 1997. His 12-month target price is $75.
